title: Align remaining context-nudge timing wording with advisory background delivery
outcome: All context-nudge documentation and related comments distinguish requesting an advisory read from delivering an already cached page.
acceptance: The host adapter and architecture descriptions plus related comments say an uncached nudge is requested by a dispatch and delivered by a later prompt; 'next prompt carries it' is retained only where a page is already available.
The distinction covers first prompts and explicit compact-hook failure without changing compact-hook ticket semantics or asynchronous prompt delivery.
